_comment: Per-MODULE champion registry for the Ladrillo benchmark. Promotion is manual and
'tag' must have a frozen snapshot under benchmark/reference/<tag>/.
Champions are per module because a change that improves one module and leaves the
others untouched should not silently take credit for them.

ais.why: Floored glacier equilibrium + bounded regrowth replaces an unphysical melt-only ratchet (Marcus 2026-08-31). Adopts the position that the ratchet was manufacturing the old AIS amplification constraint: a 2x2 (L21/L22/L23/L23b) shows the law moves ais_gmst_amp 1.43 prior sd and AIS@2300 by 66 cm, against 4.93 cm between-refit reproducibility. Promoted 2026-09-01 with that attribution explicit and the identifiability question open.
